en.title: Hideo Kojima Confirms 'Big' Live-Action Movie Cameo, Fans Speculate Wildly
en.summary: The legendary game designer Hideo Kojima has revealed he has a cameo in a major upcoming live-action film, leaving fans eager to uncover the secret project. While details remain scarce, Kojima's deep love for cinema fuels intense speculation.
en.body:
Hideo Kojima, the visionary creator behind **Metal Gear Solid** and **Death Stranding**, has dropped a tantalizing hint that he will soon appear on the silver screen. During a recent installment of his Koji10 podcast, Kojima confirmed that he has filmed a cameo for a "big" live-action movie, though he remains tight-lipped about the specific title.

This news comes as no surprise to those familiar with Kojima's lifelong passion for film. His social media often features movie reviews, and he famously quipped that "70% of my body is made of movies." This deep connection to cinema has always informed his game design, creating experiences that are as cinematic as they are interactive. While his voice acting work in the Japanese version of *Zootopia 2* was behind the scenes, this new project promises a visible presence. 

> "I already shot a few other things. Directors and others have asked me to." — Hideo Kojima

Kojima's secrecy surrounding the project only fuels the intrigue. He even declined to reveal where the scenes were shot, emphasizing the clandestine nature of his involvement. This isn't his only recent foray into visual media; he also made a surprise appearance in the Japanese live-action TV series **VIVANT**, playing Watanuki Ken, the Commissioner General of Japan’s National Police Agency. Details about his involvement in an anime and a secret game cameo also remain undisclosed, suggesting a busy period for the acclaimed developer.

## The Speculation Game Begins

The gaming and film communities are already abuzz with theories. Given Kojima's well-documented admiration for filmmakers like Denis Villeneuve, some fans are pinning their hopes on a **Dune: Part 3** appearance. Others have pointed to the recent release of **Godzilla: Minus Zero**, which opened in Japan in November 2026, as a potential candidate, given its "big movie" status. The sheer volume of unconfirmed projects he's hinted at — including a secret game cameo and two major anime projects — means the possibilities are vast, and fans are meticulously dissecting every clue.

## What's Next

While Kojima has not provided a release window for his big-screen cameo, the ongoing speculation suggests fans will be eagerly awaiting any official announcement. His continued engagement with both gaming and live-action film solidifies his unique position as a bridge between these powerful storytelling mediums.

content_raw: Hideo Kojima teased that he's got a cameo in a "big" live-action movie, but he's not saying which one we'll see him in quite yet. The Metal Gear Solid and Death Stranding creator enticed film fans to theorize about his movie career during a surprise installment in the Koji10 podcast . In between talking about Physint and what's next for his Kojima Productions, the famed game developer revealed that he would appear in movie theaters as part of a big new live-action movie cameo. "I already shot a few other things," Kojima said, as translated through YouTube's English captions (via @Genki_JPN ). "Directors and others have asked me to." The topic came up when reminiscing about his time doing voice acting work as a mole in Zootopia 2 . While the Japanese version of the Pixar film had him provide his talents behind the scenes, he suggested this mysterious new project will allow him to be in front of the camera in some capacity. So as not to spoil the surprise, he said he "can't say" what it is yet, but it is a "big movie." It is indeed live-action, too, but his involvement is so secretive for now that he even refused to tell his hosts where he shot his part. Kojima is best known for his work as a game developer, but he's also a well-read cinephile, too. Fans routinely turn up for his reviews of movies like Superman , Backrooms , Spider-Man: Brand New Day , and more. Even his social media biography jokes that "70% of my body is made of movies," so it's no surprise to see him continue to be as involved in film as he can manage. Many have also already started speculating when exactly we'll see Kojima show up, too, even if no one has any truly solid leads to go on yet. Some have guessed we'll see him in Denis Villeneuve's Dune: Part 3 this December, while others suggested he'll show up in The Legend of Zelda movie , or even next month's Godzilla Minus Zero . Other guesses come from those who are just happy to see their favorite game creator show up in live-action at all. "Hideo Kojima will return in Avengers: Doomsday," one fan said . Kojima also said his future in entertainment will see him in not one but two "major anime" titles. These are "really big" but still a mystery for audiences for now, with the developer only saying that he has speaking lines coming up. He also said that an upcoming game cameo – a concept that is far from new for him – is also a secret, though fans have already found evidence that he's been scanned for Naughty Dog's Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet . In terms of Kojima's main occupation, he's still very much at work on his new espionage action game, Physint. He offered an update on the Bill Skarsgård-starring title's progress during today's podcast, too, teasing that many of the characters' names have already been decided, and their actors scanned. He's also still heads-down working on his horror game, OD . Photo by Rosdiana Ciaravolo/Getty Images.
